verdict.rationale: TruffleHog OSS is a self-hosted/open-source CLI that outputs findings in JSON (an open format) and can route results via webhooks, and users can also choose self-hosted deployment over the hosted SaaS option, which inherently avoids vendor lock-in for scan configs and results. However, there is no explicit documentation of a bulk 'export all my data and leave' feature for the hosted/enterprise platform (e.g., account data, findings history, dashboards) beyond ad hoc webhook routing. Missing for 10: documented full data export/migration tooling for the hosted platform, explicit account data portability guarantees, and independent confirmation that hosted users can fully extract their data.
